mechanism: exact group homomorphism U(m)->Fock (passive linear optics) restricted to monomial matrices; transposition-product collapse with Z4 phase bookkeeping

rule.name: passive_full_hop_run_permutation_collapse
rule.idea: A maximal contiguous run of oscillator-only passive gates (BS at t=pi mod 2pi, phase a multiple of pi/2; R at phi a multiple of pi/2) is, on the single-photon subspace, exactly a monomial matrix M = Perm(sigma) * diag(i^{c_x}); since passive linear optics U(m)->Fock is a phase-free homomorphism fixing vacuum, two such circuits agree on all of Fock space iff their m x m matrices agree. Content tracking through the run (integer phases mod 4, ints only) gives sigma and per-content phases exactly; sigma is then resynthesized as a shortest sequence of BS(pi,0) transpositions along already-coupled qumode edges (BFS), and the residual integer phase per final mode is emitted as a single R(k*pi/2). This collapses e.g. a 12-BS all-pairs hopping block (which needs 24 router SWAPs when routed naively) into 2 BS + 4 R with zero router SWAPs, verified by exact integer matrix recomputation before acceptance.
